LOAD-BEARING AND NUMERICALLY VERIFIED against the PDF: the document states that a Riemann matrix for Bring's curve is tau_B = tau_0 M with tau_0 = -0.5 + 0.186676i (6 d.p.), characterised by j(tau_0) = -29^3 x 5 / 2^5 and j(5 tau_0) = -25/2, and explicitly records that an earlier source had the two j-values SWAPPED (first noted in the intermediate paper the corpus also cites). The corpus's j(tau_0) = -5 x 29^3 / 2^5 = -121945/32, its tau_0 = -0.5 + 0.18667646246... at 50 dps, and its note that the earlier source swapped them all reproduce this document exactly. The X_0(50) elliptic-quotient identification the reference entry claims is also present (text line 1728). The corpus treats these as PUBLISHED INPUTS, not derived quantities, and the alpha-em ledger keeps 1/(8 pi) OPEN - so this is a clean literature-value citation, not a laundered fit.

Cited at twelve-plus Lean sites across QOU/Archimedean/ (BringEllipticFactor, BringHauptmodulGate, HodgeGramLift, PeriodMapWeightReduction, TauRhoHodgeShadow, TauRhoHodgeLiftInterface, B2LiftAutomaticIngredients, PerLoopMeasureShadowAssembly, SigmaJGeometricCarrier, TauFunctorAssembly, VertexLocalTauModel, HodgeWeilRealStructure). Load-bearing and VERIFIED numerically against the source: BringHauptmodulGate.lean:41 cites the key for j(tau_0) = -121945/32, and this document gives j(tau_0) = -(5 x 29^3)/2^5, which is -(5 x 24389)/32 = -121945/32 exactly. The document also confirms the second half of the corpus's citation - it notes that the earlier Riera-Rodriguez equations for j(tau_0) and j(5 tau_0) were incorrectly labelled, which is precisely the correction the Lean attributes to braden-northover-2012 in the adjacent comment. The paper's other results (complete automorphism realisation for a plane-curve model, the new elliptic quotient identified with X_0(50), the theta-characteristic orbit decomposition, the invariant characteristic as the divisor of the Szego kernel) are the Bring's-curve inputs the Archimedean modules build on.

keyResults.statement: Bring's curve is the unique genus-4 Riemann surface with automorphism group S_5; the paper gives a new elliptic quotient identified with the modular curve X_0(50) and identifies the unique S_5-invariant theta characteristic with the divisor of the Szego kernel.
keyResults.useForFolio: The S_5 structure and the invariant theta characteristic are the geometric inputs the TauRhoHodge / period-map modules cite; having the published version pins the statements.
